chunks: Sufficient is Allah as a Reckoner.
Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, said: 'Indeed, Allah will make the people account for what they do.'
And He said: 'And your Lord is not unjust to the servants.'

key_terms.وَكَيْلًا: A Reckoner / One who measures exactly
key_terms.يُحَاسِبُ: He makes account / He holds to account

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about Allah's justice in holding people accountable?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq utilizes these verses to anchor the Shia doctrine of *Hisab* (accountability) in explicit divine promise, reinforcing the concept of *Adl* (divine justice). This establishes that the Reckoner is not only sufficient in power but also inherently just, ensuring that no servant is wronged in the final judgment, a key tenet distinguishing Shia theology from other schools.
